propositions: Six reconciler-imported rollout comment bodies on three tickets each have two live Jira copies instead of one, with rollout IDs 997143/997144/997145/997255/997256/997293 created by runs 32447039101 and 32447697242 and survivors at 963510/963511/963512/963788/963789/964272.

Preparation must build an immutable manifest validating exact one-survivor + one-deletion-target per group, produce a digest-bound GET-only-by-default Jira cleanup tool with durable intent/outcome journal, and create a local Git rewrite removing only enumerated COMMENT material and non-survivor snapshots.

Execution requires disabling .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml before any Jira DELETE or history mutation, then deleting exact six manifest IDs in canary order with post-verification survivor and non-target parity before re-enabling.

Whole-store replay and threshold-free measurements must verify commit topology, authorship, retained bytes, bridge parity, fsck, and that no preparation helper can push refs, that dry-run cannot DELETE Jira, and that all preconditions fail before external mutation.

Frozen-mirror and real-store rehearsals must independently restore complete bundles, prove exact-lease rollback/forward and stale-epoch refusal, and record manifest delta and logical byte removal without mutating Jira or authoritative refs.

The runbook must directly verify GitHub Actions disablement and run drainage, freeze and back up both Jira and Git inputs, execute and verify exact-six Jira cleanup, obtain two unchanged production-equivalent dry-run observations while workflow is disabled, publish verified Git candidate with exact old-tip lease, replace persistent clones, and re-enable only after non-resurrection checks.
